description: This file is a shell script implementing a test suite for Git hooks, specifically for prepare-commit-msg hooks. It sets up various test scenarios to verify hook behavior during commits, rebases, merges, and cherry-picks, including failure cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_hook --setup
methods.description: Sets up a hook with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_hook --remove
methods.description: Removes a previously set up hook.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command fails.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion.
